description: Non-canonical field vectors (docs/wire-contract.md, Authentication, "Token spelling"; bug-fix ledger F53). Each case is the valid case of cases.json with its access token or its DPoP proof spelled another way that a lenient base64url decoder reads as the same bytes: a nonzero spare bit in a segment's last character, '=' padding, the standard alphabet ('+', '/'), a line feed, carriage return or CRLF inside a segment, whitespace around the proof, or such a spelling of the proof key's x or y. A re-spelled signature is the same bytes; a re-spelled header, payload or coordinate is signed again over its new text with the fixture key, and the proof of a re-spelled token carries the ath of that exact text, so a verifier that decodes leniently accepts every case and only the spelling rule refuses it. Every verifier must refuse every case: expect is "malformed" for a re-spelled access token (not RFC 7515 base64url, so not a compact JWS) and "invalid_proof" for a re-spelled proof. Whitespace around the access token is not a case: it is outside the token, in the Authorization header. The verifier is configured as for cases.json (issuer, appCode, the JWKS next to this file) and the Authorization header is "DPoP " + accessToken. Generated by tools/field-fixtures; do not edit.
